head: a384627ca (origin/wip/combat)

findings.title: The default unparriable rule marks most of several bosses' attacks, not "only some big" ones, and flips inside single moves
findings.where: roguelike/data/rlk/function/mboss/hz/np_def.mcfunction:5-10 (generator tools/build_mboss_core.py; README 0-9 "전투 개편 C" lists the share as an open note)
findings.what: User decision 11-10: 패링 불가 = "보스의 일부 큰 공격만(범위 공격 · 잡기 등)". np_def makes every no-dodge / per-mille / re-arming / ring / full / mask hazard, every disc r >= 4.5 b and every sector or line reaching >= 8 b unparriable. Counted pattern by pattern (not hazard by hazard) an unparriable part is in 4 of 8 Guardian attacks (P1 thrust, P2 javelin lane, P3 slam, P5 dive: all four ordinary strikes except P4), 5 of 9 fieldgen, 14 of 23 Azhdaha groups, 10 of 12 Apep groups, 11 of 21 Arlecchino patterns, 4 of 12 Tachy, 2 of 9 butterfly. The size thresholds also give one move two answers: Arlecchino D rush lane is parryable at 2 b and unparriable at 14 b (length = distance to the player), A 4/5-hit combo: hits 3 and 5 (spin r 4.6 / 4.8) unparriable between parryable r 4.2 hits, Q6 landing r 4.0 parryable but its orb discs r 5.0 not, Q3 spin r 4.6 not while Q1 spin r 4.2 is; Tachy 연속기 hit 2 (disc r 5.0) unparriable inside a parryable string, her dash lane unparriable only from range; Azhdaha chin: disc r 5.0 unparriable + sector r 5.6 parryable made for the same strike (a parry only works in the 5.0-5.6 b band); Apep 4-hit combo: only hit 1 parryable; butterfly B1: 10 b lane unparriable + sector parryable in one strike. The Guardian's failure spear (D220, her biggest hit) and Raiden's r 19 / r 12 attacks stay parryable (Raiden uses a different rule: no-dodge only).
findings.evidence: Reviewer harness (hzlog.py on the vendored sims; records the scores of every hazard at rlk:mboss/hz/init during forced / locked patterns): e.g. guardian p/thrust K4 R9300/8400 NP1, p/slam K1 R6000 NP1, p/flyslam K1 R5500 NP1, p/pull K3 R6800 NP0, p/fail K1 R3400 D220 NP0; arlecchino p/d1/k/25 "K4 R2000 ... NP0" and "K4 R14000 ... NP1" in the same run, p/a5/k/43 K1 R4600 NP1 next to p/a5/k/13 K3 R4200 NP0, p/q6 "K1 R4000 NP0 x2 / K1 R5000 NP1 x16"; tachy p/c1/k/31 K1 R5000 NP1 among p/c1 sectors NP0; azhdaha p/chin/hz "K1 R5000 NP1 x7" + "K3 R5600 NP0 x7"; apep p/combo k/4 K3 R7200 NP0, k/32 + hit3 + hit4 K1 R6600-7200 NP1. Full list: unparriable_table.
findings.repro: Copy tools/dev/sim outside the pack (sim README 1 B); with the hr/tests/lib sims start each boss as bal/tests/test_bal_boss.py does, hook Sim.call after rlk:mboss/hz/init and print mbHzK/R/W/D/ND/Pm/RA/NP while running /function rlk:mboss/test/pattern {id:N} (lock {id:N}) for every id. Static cross-check: grep the generated p/**/k/*.mcfunction for hz/disc {r:46..}, hz/line with len >= 80.
findings.fix: Make np_def unparriable only for no-dodge, per-mille, full-arena and mask hazards (re-arming fields unparriable without a glint) and let the modules name their big hits with L.hz_opts(noparry=1): the per-boss list in unparriable_table "Proposed rule" (about a quarter per boss). Keep one answer per move (all hazards of one strike share the flag).

findings.title: Tachy and Arlecchino: the unparriable warning glint comes 1 tick before the hit
findings.where: roguelike/data/rlk/function/mboss/hz/init.mcfunction:83 (glint at hazard creation); roguelike/data/rlk/function/boss/arlecchino/p/a5/k/43.mcfunction:6 and roguelike/data/rlk/function/boss/tachy/p/a1/k/13.mcfunction:12 (tell:1), all s3lib strike hazards
findings.what: Decision: unparriable attacks are "원작처럼 색 섬광으로 미리 보여 줌"; telegraph rule (README 0-6): >= 12 t, >= 20 t for big hits. The glint is made in hz/init, i.e. when the hazard marker is created. The s3lib bosses create each strike hazard at the clip's strike frame with tell 1, so for every unparriable attack of Tachy (dash lane, 연속기 hit 2, landing r 5.5, nova 250 per mille full arena) and Arlecchino (A spins, D lane, F and G full-arena hits, Q0 ring, Q3, Q4 beam, Q5a, Q5b, Q6 orbs) the glint appears one tick (50 ms) before the damage and lasts 6 ticks: the player cannot learn from it whether to parry or dodge, and with bosses needing a 3-tick perfect dodge the full-arena hits (연회 160 / 196, 칼날 104, 노바) have no usable cue from the new system. Mid / chapter bosses made with the old kit get W ticks (Guardian thrust and javelin 10 t, slam 13 t, dive 15 t, fieldgen slam D270 17 t).
findings.evidence: Measured in the sim (lead = tick of rlk:mboss/hz/strike minus tick of rlk:player/def/fx/glint): tachy p/a1 K4 R12000 W1 lead 1, p/c1 K1 R5000 lead 1, p/l K1 R5500 lead 1, mantle/nova K5 lead 1; arlecchino p/a5 K1 R4600 / R4800 lead 1, p/f1 K5 R26000 lead 1 (x2), p/g1 K4 R14000 lead 1 (x4), K5 lead 1; guardian thrust 10 / 12, slam 13, javelin 10, flyslam 15. Static: `grep -rn "hzW mb" boss/arlecchino boss/tachy` has no value other than 1 except the Q6 feathers / mantle discs (tell 14-16, parryable).
findings.repro: As B-01 with ids tachy 1 3 11 21, arlecchino 2 10 11 7; log the tick of every call to rlk:player/def/fx/glint and rlk:mboss/hz/strike.
findings.fix: Raise the warning from the pattern, not from hz/init: a module hook (e.g. mboss/np_warn) called at the clip tick where the tell starts, >= 12 t (>= 20 t for the full-arena / big hits) before the strike; keep hz/init's glint only for hazards whose wind-up is itself >= 12 t.

findings.title: 야타용왕: the warning glint is made 0.18 b under the floor at the rig anchor, not at her chest
findings.what: np_glint runs `execute as <body husk> at @s anchored eyes positioned ^ ^-0.35 ^ run function rlk:player/def/fx/glint` ("보스 가슴"). Azhdaha's body is a husk scaled to 0.1 standing on the floor under the centre of the four feet (hits go through the proxies), so its eye height is 1.74 x 0.1 = 0.174 b and the text_display, the dust and the end_rod particles are made at feet - 0.176 b: inside the floor block under the dragon's belly. The glint (76 of her 150 hazards by README 0-9) is therefore not where the player looks and breaks the user rule "바닥 아래로 아무것도 안 내려가고" (README 0-6). cproto has the same scale; for the other bosses the point is 1.7-3.8 b above the husk's feet.
findings.evidence: Registry: azhdaha scale 0.1 (guardian 1.5, apep 2.0, arlecchino 1.4 ...); body_scale sets minecraft:scale, which scales the eye height; np_glint line 11 subtracts 0.35 from the eye point. (The sim uses a fixed 1.62 eye height, so this one is from the code and the vanilla scale rule, checked on two files.)
findings.repro: /function rlk:boss/test/chapter {id:"azhdaha"}, /function rlk:boss/test/pattern {id:3} (jump): the bell sounds but the glint sits at the floor under her; `execute as @e[tag=rlk_cb_glint] run data get entity @s Pos` shows y = floor - 0.18.
findings.fix: Anchor the glint to a rig locator (head / chest part of the running rig) or a per-boss registry offset instead of the hit-box husk's eyes; never below the floor.

findings.title: No-dodge attacks get the same "cannot parry - dodge" glint although a perfect dodge does nothing against them
findings.what: np_def makes every #hzNoDodge hazard unparriable and init flashes the glint for it; judge2 skips the perfect dodge (and the i-frames) when #hcND is 1. So for Azhdaha whip (9 sectors r 12, D129), feint lane, slide rings, bolt masks, fieldgen 인력 충격파, Apep glow wheels and Q2 aftermath, Raiden's nododge discs the yellow glint - which in the original (the user's wiki text: unparriable attacks "닷지로는 모두 피할 수 있음") and in README 3 means "dodge it" - announces an attack that neither F nor a perfect dodge avoids; only the position does. The player who reacts to the cue as taught takes the full hit.
findings.evidence: judge2 line 26: `execute if score #hcND tmp matches 0 if score #jd tmp matches 0.. if score #jd tmp < #dgPW tmp run return run function rlk:player/def/pd`; hazards recorded with ND1 NP1 and a glint: azhdaha p/whip/r/3..11 K3 R12000 W20 D129, p/feint K4 R6600, p/slide K2 R4000, p/bolt/mask K6; fieldgen p/waves K2 ND1; apep p/aftermath K6 ND1, p/glow wheels (projectiles NP1 ND1).
findings.repro: sweep.py fieldgen --id=21 (인력 충격파), body 6 b from her, dgAt stamped = now on every tick (a perfect dodge on every tick): the three rings still hit - "+23 hz/hurt W24 R2500 parT 0 dodged 0 lost 10", "+97 ... dodged 0 lost 10", "+180 ... dodged 0 lost 10"; the same stamp against Azhdaha stomp rings (unparriable, not ND): "dodged 1 lost 0" each time.
findings.fix: Either let a perfect dodge avoid these (drop ND where the attack is not a jump / safe-zone check) or give position-only attacks a different cue (other colour / no glint) and correct the README sentence.

findings.title: A perfect parry that takes the last pip starts the groggy at the player's position: far props are not cancelled, the boss break flash appears over the player
findings.where: roguelike/data/rlk/function/player/def/par3_go.mcfunction:4 (`execute as @e[tag=rlk_hc_atk,limit=1] run function rlk:bal/hit {n:1}`, no `at @s`); roguelike/data/rlk/function/bal/grog/start.mcfunction:1 ("@s = enemy, at @s"); roguelike/data/rlk/function/cm/cancel.mcfunction:5-7, cm/pose_s.mcfunction:1, cm/c2/cancel.mcfunction:2-3 (distance=..8 / ..4 / ..6 from the execution position); roguelike/data/rlk/function/bal/fx/start.mcfunction:2-5
findings.what: bal/grog/start and the family adapters assume the enemy's position (the burst / reaction path enters through combat/apply `as <mob> at @s`). The parry path - the main source - runs them at the player's eyes. (1) cm mobs: bal/fam/cm_on -> cm/cancel looks for the attack props within 8 b of the player, so a ranged attacker keeps them: a fire mage 12 b away keeps its held fireballs through the whole groggy and fires them with the next volley (5 balls instead of 3); the mannequin pose reset (4 b) and the swarm glow / ring cleanup (6 b) miss the same way. (2) bosses: the "balance broke" flash and dust of bal/fx/start (`positioned ~ ~2.2 ~`) and the break sounds are made 2.2 b above the player's eyes instead of over the boss; every module bal_on (rig, lib_clear, px) also runs at the player's position (no wrong teleport found: the rig followers return early while the body has not moved since its own rig tick).
findings.evidence: Sim t_fm.py (balsim, real cm/fm/* + cm/cancel): mage 12 b from the player, ball 1 in flight, 2 still held, `bal/hit {n:1}` on its last pip. A. called at the player's eyes: "held fireballs left after cm_on: 2 ... end of the groggy: still there 2 (cmN [2, 3]) ... next volley: fireballs launched 5 (a volley is 3)". B. control at the enemy: 0 / 0 / 3. Bosses (postrace.py, all 8): e.g. guardian body (200.3, 201.0, 19.4), bal/fx/burst particles at (200.5, 202.6 + 2.2, 25.5).
findings.repro: Sim: BalSim with real cm/fm/*; brain at (0.5,201,0.5), body at (12.5,201,0.5), bal 1, run cm/tick until the first ball is launched, then call rlk:bal/hit {n:1} with executor = brain and position = the body's eyes; count rlk_cmfbh, run the groggy, run the next volley. In game: /function rlk:cm/test {t:"fm"}, perfect-parry fireballs from 10+ b until the gauge breaks.
findings.fix: bal/hit: `execute at @s run function rlk:bal/take` (or par3_go `... as <enemy> at @s run ...`); bal/fx/start for bosses at the body (or its rig head).

findings.title: 1챕터 궁수: a perfectly parried arrow takes no pip (the arrow carries no owner id)
findings.where: roguelike/data/rlk/function/cm/ar/shoot.mcfunction:2-8 (the arrow gets cmD / cmLv / cmEl / cmT, no cmId); roguelike/data/rlk/function/player/def/ctx_cm.mcfunction:11; roguelike/data/rlk/function/player/def/par3_go.mcfunction:4
findings.what: ctx_cm resolves a projectile's owner by the projectile's cmId (`unless entity @s[tag=rlk_cmb] if score @s cmId matches 1.. run function rlk:player/def/ctx_owner`). The archer's arrow is a new block_display summoned in cm/ar/shoot without a cmId (fireballs, icicles, cannon balls, shuriken and vulture feathers carry one), so no entity is tagged rlk_hc_atk and par3_go's bal/hit has no executor: the perfect parry shows its effect and cuts the cooldown but the archer's 4 diamonds never move. test_cb only covers a hand-made projectile with cmId set.
findings.evidence: Sim t_ar.py (real cm/ar/start, fire, shoot, ctx_cm, ctx_owner): "arrows 1 tags [rlk_cmp, rlk_cmp_ar] cmId on the arrow = None; attacker tagged (rlk_hc_atk): [] -> the archer keeps 4 / 4 pips". `git diff 2dcc742 a384627ca -- data/rlk/function/cm/ar` changes only rig/tick.
findings.repro: BalSim: spawn an rlk_cm_ar brain (cmId 7), #cid tmp 7, run cm/ar/start then cm/ar/fire, run player/def/ctx_cm as the rlk_cmp_ar entity, list entities with rlk_hc_atk.
findings.fix: cm/ar/shoot: `scoreboard players operation @e[tag=rlk_cmpnew] cmId = @s cmId` (the line entity has the owner's id) before the kill; add the real archer / mage / cannon projectiles to test_cb.

findings.title: 2챕터 번개 시킨 술사: her groggy does not stop the cicins, and parrying a cicin never reduces her gauge
findings.where: roguelike/data/rlk/function/cm/cc/tick.mcfunction:5 (flock runs before the #free gate at :11); roguelike/data/rlk/function/cm/cc/flock.mcfunction:12; roguelike/data/rlk/function/cm/cc/ci_own.mcfunction:2 (tag remove rlk_cmb, own cmId kept, c2eOw = caster); roguelike/data/rlk/function/bal/init.mcfunction:16
findings.what: The conjurer's only attack is the cicin ram. cm/cc/flock picks and sends a cicin every 30 t whenever one is idle, without looking at the caster's stun / freeze / groggy, so during her 80-tick groggy (stars, orange row, +40 % damage) the rams go on. And an owned cicin is not a brain (no rlk_cmb), has no gauge (rlk_cm_ci excluded) and keeps its own cmId, so ctx_owner finds no brain: a perfect parry of a ram takes a pip from nobody. For this elite the user's first source (perfect parry) does not exist and the groggy does not make her harmless. (A frozen caster behaves the same today; the groggy inherited it.)
findings.evidence: Sim t_cc.py: elite 7 pips, bal/hit {n:7} -> grgT 80, NoAI 1; 79 groggy ticks of bal/tick + cm/tick with 4 owned idle cicins: "cicin rams started while the caster was groggy: 3 [(0,..),(30,..),(60,..)]". Sim t_cc2.py (real cm/cc/ci_own, ctx_cm, ctx_owner): cicin tags [rlk_cm_ci, rlk_cmlink, rlk_cmsync, rlk_room], cmId 8, c2eOw 7 -> "attacker tagged for the perfect-parry pip: []".
findings.repro: As the two sims; in game /function rlk:cm/test {t:"cc"}, break her gauge with a burst + reactions and watch the cicins keep ramming; perfect-parry rams and watch her 7 diamonds.
findings.fix: cm/cc/flock: no flock_ram while the caster's grgT (and stunT / frzT if wanted) is >= 1; ctx_cm: an entity with c2eOw resolves to the brain whose cmId = c2eOw.

findings.title: Tachy: a balance groggy during the side-step hop leaves her kneeling up to 0.6 b above the floor, and she attacks from there afterwards
findings.what: bal_ok allows patterns 0-9. In pattern 3 (옆걸음 4연격) the body glides on an arc; bal_on stops the glide where it is. The body is a NoGravity NoAI husk, so she stays 0.33-0.60 b up for the 100 groggy ticks and the next pattern starts from that height. Arlecchino, Scarlet and Azhdaha ground the body in the same case; Tachy's blink (pattern 8, 6 b up) is grounded by its own cancel.
findings.evidence: okscan.py tachy --at=174..180 (groggy forced on those fight ticks): "AT 178 pat (3, air, mv) y 201.6 ... +50 grgT 50 y 201.60 ... +100 grgT 0 y 201.60 ... +160 y 201.60 pat 5" (floor 201.0); pattern 8 at y 207.0 -> 201.00.
findings.repro: hr sim special fight tachy, run until #pat tk = 3 and the body y > 201.3, call rlk:bal/hit {n:12}, tick with mob/tick's bal line, read the body y.
findings.fix: bal_on: put the body on the floor (as boss/arlecchino/core/ground: `execute at @s positioned ~ 201 ~ if function rlk:mboss/mv/ok run tp @s ~ ~ ~`, else the arena centre).

findings.title: Pips are taken from a boss that is not in play (Apep revival phase): the gauge empties while she is parked and the groggy starts the moment phase 3 allows it
findings.where: roguelike/data/rlk/function/bal/boss/may.mcfunction:4-6 (only #mbSt 1, no cutscene, bars on); roguelike/data/rlk/function/mboss/hurt_ctx.mcfunction:10 (every boss-fight hit names the body as the attacker)
findings.what: In Apep's phase 2 the body is parked and cannot be hit; the org creatures (aux, no gauge) shoot. Their shots are parryable and the attacker of every mboss/hurt is the body, so each perfect parry takes a pip from the parked boss; at 0 it is "pending" and the groggy starts on the first tick bal_ok allows. The spec point "never during invulnerable phases" holds for the groggy itself but not for the gauge. The same applies to any hit of an aux object or lingering hazard while the module refuses (Guardian chaos stars, fieldgen field).
findings.evidence: apep2.py (chapter fight, #apPh mb set to 2 as the revival phase has it; the hr sim cannot run that phase's own functions - `execute on` is not implemented - which is also why test_bal_boss has no Apep phase case): 12 x bal/hit {n:1} -> "bal 0 pending True grgT 0 last return 1"; phase flag back -> "3 ticks later: grgT 98".
findings.repro: As the sim; in game /function rlk:boss/test/pattern {id:20} (revival) and perfect-parry the creatures' shots: the boss-bar row empties.
findings.fix: bal/boss/may: also ask the module (a cheap bal_may hook or reuse bal_ok for the states where the body is parked / invulnerable), or let hurt_ctx tag no attacker for aux / org-creature hazards.

findings.title: Swept attacks made of per-tick wedges: after a perfect dodge of one wedge the next wedge, one tick later, still hits
findings.where: roguelike/data/rlk/function/mboss/hz/hurt.mcfunction:23 (the volley group is marked only for a real hit); roguelike/data/rlk/function/boss/apep/p/tail/swing1.mcfunction (8 wedges, ticks 28-35); also p/tail/swing2, p/tail3
findings.what: Apep's tail swings are unparriable (r 11.4-12 sectors) and are 8 wedges one tick apart in one volley group. A dodged wedge does not disarm the group, so where two consecutive wedges cover the player the perfect-dodge press window is 2 ticks instead of 3: the earliest valid press avoids the first wedge and is hit by the second (D130-140). Before the overhaul the 5-6 i-frame ticks covered both.
findings.evidence: sweep.py apep --id=5, player 8 b from her at -30 deg: with a perfect dodge forced every tick two wedges register ("+16 hz/hurt W17 ... dodged 1", "+17 hz/hurt W18 ... dodged 1"; same at -10 deg; one wedge at -50, 10, 30, 50). One dodge stamp one tick earlier than the latest two-wedge-safe press: "+16 W17 dodged 1 lost 0 / +17 W18 dodged 0 lost 28".
findings.repro: cmsim chapter fight apep, /function rlk:mboss/test/pattern {id:5}; place the body 8 b away at -30 deg of her facing when the wedges exist; set dgAt so that d = 2 on the first wedge tick; read the dmg log.
findings.fix: A perfect dodge (and a perfect parry) of a member of a swept volley disarms the wedges of that swing (mark the group for #pdg / tier 3 when the module flags the volley as one swing), or widen the wedge spacing.

findings.title: Raiden: field / safe-dome hazards (kinds 9, 10) are unparriable but only no-dodge hazards flash the glint
findings.where: roguelike/data/rlk/function/boss/raiden/hazard/new.mcfunction:29-32 (glint only when nd = 1); roguelike/data/rlk/function/boss/raiden/hazard/land.mcfunction:16-17 (#hcNP also for kinds 9..10)
findings.what: hazard/land sets #hcNP for nododge hazards and for kinds 9 and 10; hazard/new calls fx/rd_glint only for nd = 1. patterns/19's lingering field (kind 9, nd 0) is therefore unparriable without the announced cue (a 3-damage field, so the effect is small; the 만겁 dome is nd and does flash).
findings.evidence: Table of every `hazard/new {..}` call in boss/raiden/**: "patterns/19 kind 9 nd 0 NP 1 tell 2 dmg 3".
findings.repro: grep -rn "hazard/new {k:9" data/rlk/function/boss/raiden; read hazard/new:29-32 and hazard/land:15-17.
findings.fix: Either flash for kinds 9 / 10 too or (better, as for the mid-boss fields) treat a lingering field as a zone without a glint and say so in README 3.

findings.title: README: boss sections still describe avoiding with dash i-frames; the glint sentence is wrong for no-dodge attacks
findings.where: roguelike/README.md:1464, 1499, 1535, 2052, 2192, 2201, 2304 (and the 홍련 lines 2247-2311 that lane H rewrites); README 3절 "패링 불가 공격 / 경고 섬광"
findings.what: Changed systems are documented in sections 2, 3 and 0-9, but the per-boss sections were not touched: Guardian "대시 무적으로 모두 피할 수 있다" (now only a 3-tick perfect dodge, and P1 / P2 / P3 / P5 cannot be parried), "대시를 남겨 둔다" (there are no charges), Tachy nova "대시로 피함", Arlecchino F / Q5 "대시로 피함", the framework group note "대시로 피한 것은". README 3 says of the glint "패링해도 효과 없음(제 피해), 퍼펙트 닷지는 피한다", which is false for the no-dodge hazards that also flash (B-04), and "보스 가슴" is not where it is made for Azhdaha (B-03). items.md / engravings.md match the code (dodge wording, 질주 2 = -20 % cooldown -> 9 t).
findings.repro: Read the listed lines against player/def/judge2 and load (#dgPW 3, #dashCoolBase 12).
findings.fix: One pass over the boss sections after the unparriable list is settled: per pattern "패링 가능 / 불가 · 퍼펙트 닷지 · 자리".

checked: Gates on a384627ca: loadcheck (26.3 server) 0 function load failures; bal/tests/test_bal.py 117/117; test_bal_boss.py 129/129; cb/tests/test_rm.py 72/72; perf_harness test_lag PASS, test_consts PASS; check_refs: no new missing reference vs 2dcc742 except the known macro name player/def/fx/g/t_$(g).

Tiers / exclusions: bal/init gives 4 / 7 / 12 by rlk_c2e / rlk_c3e / rlk_mb_body / rlk_raiden; pets, rlk_mb_aux / hit / px, Raiden objects, spore pods, cicins, lobby dummies get none (code + test T); burrowers (sb, cs) keep the gauge and get the row back; orphan rows die with the head bar (hb_cleanup).

Sources: all 7 characters' bursts call items/hook/burst_dmg (Lumine re-arms it at jav_hit); #rx is reset per hit (element/on_hit:4); burst 2 pips / 40 t and reactions / 30 t per target (test S); a groggy start inside combat/apply does not change the damage of that hit (8 bosses x 4 fight times: HP lost identical with and without the groggy starting).

cm groggy: the per-mob ticks that test_bal C does not run were read (im cn pc cc nj ns sl ss sp dr fu em sb cw cs ci): every attack start is gated by #free, grgT or the held cooldown (exception = B-07); NoAI restore in both freeze orders (test V), drummer stops, brood cycle stops; no stuck state found for cs / sb / nj / rv.

Boss groggy: all 11 registry adapters + Raiden read; allowed states scanned in 2500-4000 tick fights: Azhdaha (jump), Arlecchino (leap), Scarlet (A4 / A7), Tachy blink are grounded, the Guardian's dive invulnerability is removed; own stuns refill the gauge (bal/refill at 9 places) and a balance groggy cannot chain with them; death while groggy cleans up (test 7); pause stops the boss clock.

### Proposed rule
1. `mboss/hz/np_def` (the default): unparriable only for no-dodge hazards, per-mille hits, full-arena and mask hazards; a re-arming (lingering) hazard is unparriable but makes no glint. Everything else (lanes, sectors, discs, rings of any size, every projectile) is parryable unless the module says `noparry=1`.
2. Per-module `noparry=1` lists (the biggest quarter): 파수꾼 P5 + 파괴 실패 창; 나비 달빛 해제; 역장 지면 충격 (+ 인력 충격파 by rule); 야타용왕 서리 · B3 emerge · 운석 큰 원 (+ 채찍 · 페인트 · 산사태 · 벼락 by rule); 아펩 P1 꼬리 · 글로우 · 시듦 (+ Q2 여파 by rule); 타키 착지 원 (+ 노바 by rule); 아를레키노 Q4 빔 · Q5a · Q5b 마무리 · Q6 착지 (+ 연회 · 칼날 마무리 by rule).
3. The glint is made when the pattern's telegraph starts, at least 12 t (20 t for these big hits) before the strike, at a rig locator (chest / head), not at the hazard's creation and not at the hit-box husk.
4. No-dodge attacks either become perfect-dodgeable or get a different cue than the "dodge this" glint.
